items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Papa had the Sapera band. He played with nobody. That was with Freddie Capit.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)

ctx.x: From the first band on. Look, Papa had the Sapera band. He played with nobody. That was with Freddie Capit. Sapera. The Empire. The Empire. And Olympia. That was the Bunk Johnson. And the Olympia. The Bunk Johnson up on Rampart and Gradient.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: That's all in there. You got it again? That's all in there.
